breakdown.description: For curved submerged surfaces, the horizontal component equals the hydrostatic force on the vertical projection (not the horizontal projection).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification says 'Calculate the horizontal hydrostatic force component using the horizontal projection area,' which repeats the original error. The ground truth requires using the VERTICAL projection of the curved surface for the horizontal component.

breakdown.description: The vertical component is obtained from the weight of the fluid volume above the surface, not from projecting the area in the same way as the horizontal component.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification says 'Calculate the vertical hydrostatic force component using the vertical projection area,' which is a projection-based approach. The ground truth requires computing the vertical component as the weight of the imaginary column of water directly above the curved surface up to the free surface, not from a projection area.
